name: skill-guard
description: Trust gate for agent skills: scan, review, approve by content hash, and block unapproved or changed skills before Claude Code or Pi loads them
author: NOKSLABS LTD

scripts.prepare: effect-tsgo patch --oxlint --force && (effect-tsgo patch --no-typescript --tsrs --skip-missing || echo "tsrs: no Effect-patched build for this platform, just ck uses tsc") && (node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import getExePath from './node_modules/tsrs/lib/getExePath.js'; fs.mkdirSync('node_modules/.tsrs', { recursive: true }); fs.rmSync('node_modules/.tsrs/tsrs', { force: true }); fs.symlinkSync(getExePath(), 'node_modules/.tsrs/tsrs')" || echo "tsrs: no native binary to link at node_modules/.tsrs/tsrs") && (git config core.hooksPath scripts 2>/dev/null || true)
